subject.title: feat: add scalable workspace member and bot management

question: Should trusted local administrators retain a backward-compatible bot-creation command, or must every CLI invocation identify an existing authorized workspace actor with `--created-by`?
rationale: Explicit actor attribution strengthens the authorization model, but making it mandatory breaks a shipped administrative contract and existing deployment recipes; the intended trusted-local-admin boundary is a maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Preserve compatible admin behavior
options.body: Derive or select an authorized local actor for legacy CLI invocations while retaining strict actor checks for HTTP requests.

options.title: Require explicit actor
options.body: Keep `--created-by` mandatory and treat this as an intentional breaking change with all recipes, scripts, tests, and upgrade guidance updated.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatible admin behavior
recommendation.body: Derive or select an authorized local actor for legacy CLI invocations while retaining strict actor checks for HTTP requests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current bot/admin contract and both database-store foundations trace most strongly to this feature history.
